description: Golden code and system review cases focused on real findings, severity, and grounding.

cases.prompt: Review this change and prioritize any behavioral regressions in the chat flow.
expected_behaviors: Prioritize by severity and user impact.
Ground each finding in concrete behavior or contract mismatch.
disallowed_behaviors: Spend most of the review on stylistic nits.
Report speculative bugs without a plausible failure path.
